modules.title: 发送一条消息后，聊天界面需要呈现哪些状态
聊天界面负责用户看得见的对话过程

items.title: 消息列表保存上下文
items.text: 用户和对方的消息需要按时间和角色清楚区分，长对话还要保持可滚动、可读，并让新消息出现时不打断正在阅读的人。

items.title: 输入和反馈不能缺席
items.text: 发送后要让用户知道请求正在处理；网络失败、内容无法发送或回复被中断时，应显示具体状态和合适的下一步。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Chat UI 不是大语言模型、客服人员或消息传输协议。界面做得流畅不能证明回答准确；模型回复正确也不能替代发送状态、错误反馈和键盘可用性。

lessonPractice.title: 用户发送消息后断网了。聊天界面应该怎样反馈？

options.label: 保留消息，显示发送失败，并提供重试或编辑
options.feedback: 对。用户既知道发生了什么，也不会丢掉刚写的内容，还能完成下一步。

options.label: 保留消息但不标失败，等联网后在后台静默重发
options.feedback: 静默重发保住了内容，却让用户不知道消息是否送达、何时会发送，也无法决定修改或取消。

options.label: 先把消息标成已发送，再在后台持续重试直到成功
options.feedback: 这制造了错误状态，不能让界面文案代替真实传输结果。

en.title: A user sends a message and the network disconnects. What chat-interface feedback fits best?

options.label: Keep the unsent message, clearly show sending failed, and offer retry or edit-and-send-again
options.feedback: Correct. The person knows what happened, does not lose the text, and has a usable next step.

options.label: Delete the message so the chat list looks cleaner
options.feedback: The person cannot know whether it was delivered and may lose text that is hard to recreate.

options.label: Show a successful reply first and handle it when the network returns
options.feedback: That fabricates state; interface wording cannot replace an actual delivery result.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请完善这个 Chat UI：消息列表要区分双方消息，输入区发送后显示等待，失败时保留原消息并提供重试。不要改模型提示词或回答内容；改完后实际测试发送成功、等待和断网失败三种状态。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Complete this Chat UI: distinguish both sides in the message list, show pending after sending from the input area, and keep the original message with retry on failure. Do not alter the model prompt or response content. Test successful send, pending, and offline failure states afterward.

learning.assumes: You have used customer-support chat, team messaging, or an AI conversation product.
learning.outcome: You can check whether a chat task shows send, pending, reply, and failure, and separate interface problems from model-answer quality.

modules.title: Which states a chat UI must show after one message is sent
What the chat interface owns in a conversation

items.title: The message list keeps context
items.text: Messages from each role need clear order and distinction. A long conversation must remain scrollable and readable, and new messages should not interrupt someone reading earlier content.

items.title: Input and feedback cannot disappear
items.text: After send, people need to know work is in progress. Network failures, unsendable content, and interrupted replies require a specific state and a useful next action.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A chat UI is not a language model, a support person, or a messaging protocol. A smooth interface cannot prove an answer is correct; a correct model answer cannot replace sending state, error feedback, and keyboard usability.
